en: Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, and leading-outward, there arises a state that is not non-demonstrable and non-reactive and not leading-outward, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are six; under predominance condition there are six … [as above] … under non-disappearance condition there are six.

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, and not leading-outward, there arises a state that is neither non-demonstrable-and-reactive nor not leading-outward, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are three … [as above] … under non-disappearance condition there are three.
